column3: Spec conformance of the untraced protocols

The rule is fail's loop over a chunk's later versions (replica.go), and cutting it breaks nothing: a member refuses each later version of a chunk past one it failed (replica.go, memberUpdate's failed check), and a version failing on the primary's own log fails the later ones queued behind it, so each is refused in its own right; the model's wait comes from its refusal costing a fault
